title_it: Rilasci automatici: un'approvazione su GitHub al posto dei passi a mano
after_it: Apri https://app.bubalina.it ed entra una volta: è la nuova casa dell'app; il vecchio indirizzo Netlify funziona ancora fino a v1.08b
_help: One file per release, written by Claude with the version (RELEASING.md). order: functions and database, in the order they must go live (the site is always last). force: parts to deploy even if git shows no change, honoured only by the release that edits this file (here: the first publication on GitHub Pages). after_it: steps left for people, shown in the Bot feed message.
